title: Browse the module roadmap and begin a lesson
description: This verifies that a learner can open the dashboard, choose a Calculus 2 module, and start the study flow from the roadmap.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the module roadmap is displayed
Click a module from the roadmap
Verify the theory lesson for the selected module is displayed

title: Solve a quiz question with a correct drag and drop
description: This verifies that a learner can complete a quiz step by placing an answer into the correct drop area and advance successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/quiz
Drag a correct answer option into the matching dropzone
Verify the answer is accepted and the quiz advances

title: Read the theory lesson for a selected module
description: This verifies that a learner can open a module theory page and see the lesson content needed to continue studying.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/theory
Verify the theory lesson content is displayed
Verify lesson formulas or mathematical content are displayed

title: Complete the quiz and see the result
description: This verifies that a learner can finish the full quiz question set and reach the final result state.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/quiz
Complete the quiz by placing answers into the dropzones
Verify the quiz result is displayed
Verify the completed state is displayed

title: Continue from theory into the next study activity
description: This verifies that a learner can finish reading theory and proceed into the next activity in the module flow.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/theory
Click the control to continue to the next activity
Verify the next study activity is displayed

title: Complete a drag and drop challenge
description: This verifies that a learner can arrange challenge items correctly and submit a completed challenge outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/calculus-2/challenge
Drag each item into its correct position
Submit the completed challenge
Verify the completed arrangement is shown
Verify a challenge completion confirmation is visible

title: Recover from an incorrect quiz drop and try again
description: This verifies that a learner can make an incorrect quiz placement, see it rejected, and then correct the answer to continue.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/quiz
Drag an answer option into an incorrect dropzone
Verify the answer is not accepted
Drag a different answer option into the correct dropzone
Verify the quiz continues to the next question

title: Complete the flashcard review for a module
description: This verifies that a learner can open a module flashcard deck, review cards, and finish the deck successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the module on the roadmap that opens the Calculus 2 study flow
Click the option to open flashcards for the selected module
Flip through the flashcards one by one until the deck is finished
Verify the deck completion state is displayed
Verify the learner can continue to the next activity

title: Open the global leaderboard
description: This verifies that a user can navigate to the leaderboard and view player rankings after playing.

steps.description: Navigate to /ranking
Verify the global leaderboard is displayed
Verify player rankings are visible

title: Review flashcards through the deck to completion
description: This verifies that a learner can use module flashcards, progress through the deck, and finish the review session.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/flashcards
Flip a flashcard
Advance through the flashcard deck until completion
Verify the deck completion state is displayed

title: Compare progress on the global leaderboard
description: This verifies that a player can open the global ranking page and view leaderboard entries after playing.

steps.description: Navigate to /ranking
Verify the global leaderboard is displayed
Verify ranking entries are displayed

title: Start a challenge and submit a completed arrangement
description: This verifies that a learner can complete the module challenge by arranging items and submitting the final outcome.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/:moduleSlug/challenge
Arrange the challenge items into a valid solution
Submit the challenge
Verify a successful challenge result is displayed

title: Compare scores on the leaderboard
description: This verifies that a user can inspect ranking entries and compare performance across players.

steps.description: Navigate to /ranking
Verify multiple leaderboard entries are displayed
Verify scores or progress values are visible

title: Flip a flashcard to review both sides
description: This verifies that a learner can inspect a flashcard by flipping it and see the card content change as expected.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/calculus-2/flashcards
Flip the current flashcard
Verify the flashcard reveals additional study content
Verify the card remains part of the active deck

title: View the challenge activity and start arranging items
description: This verifies that a learner can open the challenge activity and see the interactive setup needed to begin solving it.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/calculus-2/challenge
Verify challenge items are displayed
Verify drop positions are displayed

title: Complete the flashcard deck and reach the end state
description: This verifies that a learner can work through the full flashcard deck and reach the finished state at the end of review.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/calculus-2/flashcards
Continue flipping through the flashcards until no cards remain
Verify the deck end state is displayed
Verify the user is prompted to move on from flashcards

title: Recover from an incorrect challenge placement
description: This verifies that a learner can make an incorrect placement in a challenge, correct it, and still complete the activity successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /modules/calculus-2/challenge
Drag an item into an incorrect position
Move the item to the correct position
Submit the completed challenge
Verify the completed arrangement is accepted
Verify a challenge success state is visible

title: View the leaderboard when only a few rankings are present
description: This verifies that the leaderboard page still presents a usable ranking view when the list is short.

steps.description: Navigate to /ranking
Verify the leaderboard content is displayed
Verify the ranking list remains readable
